subject: English
passage: Some fish species don't build their own shelters. Instead, adult females deposit their eggs inside the shells of other marine creatures, alongside those creatures' own developing offspring. Female cleaner wrasse have been observed carefully placing their eggs inside sea anemone tentacles when the anemones are contracted and inactive. After the eggs develop, the anemone hosts will typically protect the wrasse larvae as if they were their own young, even though the wrasse are much smaller than the anemone's natural offspring.
prompt: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?

choices.A: It offers a detail about how female wrasse carry out the behavior discussed in the text.
choices.B: It introduces a physical characteristic of female wrasse that is described later in the text.
choices.C: It describes the structure of the anemone shelters mentioned earlier in the text.
choices.D: It explains how anemones respond to the female wrasse behavior discussed in the text.

explanation: Choice A is the best answer because it best describes how the underlined sentence functions in the text as a whole. The first two sentences establish that fish of some species don't build their own shelters; instead, they deposit their eggs inside the shells of other marine creatures. The underlined sentence then states that female cleaner wrasse engage in this behavior, having been observed specifically placing their eggs inside anemone tentacles while the anemones are contracted. According to the text, the wrasse larvae are then protected by the anemones. Thus, the underlined sentence provides a particular detail about how female wrasse carry out the behavior of depositing eggs for other creatures to protect.
